$comment: Kill effects (docs/17 §3.7, docs/04 §7 and §8.7): what plays where a victim falls when the killer's equipped skin line carries one, on kills with that gun. Everyone who can see the spot sees it; it starts on the kill event and nothing waits for it. Limits (test/killEffects.test.ts): durationS ≤ 1.0, particles ≤ 80 (one instanced draw call from the shared atlas), the dissolve runs in the victim's own draw call, everything inside the body envelope (base body box +10%), no light past it and nothing brighter than the victim's lit body (`bodyTint` mixes into the toon colour, it never adds light). `palette`: picked per quad, so a colour listed twice comes up twice as often (the Galaxy Relic's violet, magenta and teal, a touch of gold). `still`: the variant for Reduce flashes, Reduce motion, the Low preset and a fifth effect at once: the body fades with a flat tint over the same time, no particles. `sound`: none yet (the base death sound plays).
